exercises.title: Shortest path in hops
exercises.task: Fill ShortestPath: a BFS from from that records each node's parent, then walks the parents back from to. Return nil if to cannot be reached.
hints: Mark a node as seen when you enqueue it, not when you dequeue it: otherwise it can be queued several times.
parent[next] = cur when you first see next. The start has no parent.
To build the path, start at to, follow parent until from, then reverse the slice.
